wp507_source.finding: CellUptakeReceipt canonical identity binds broadcast/selection/plan/cell/delivery/uptake/downstream/provenance refs but has no mandatory typed observer/evidence-producer identity.

lineage_propagation.causal_result: CausalInfluenceResult canonical payload includes uptake_summary_sha256 plus arm digests.
lineage_propagation.consequence: A leaf receipt binding can propagate transitively through existing digest lineage without duplicating the full observer object at every layer.

probe_arm_boundary.finding: CausalProbeArm also contains caller-supplied downstream_output_sha256 and opaque provenance_refs without a typed evidence-producer identity.
probe_arm_boundary.candidate_scope: Trigger 4 should decide whether the same ObserverBinding primitive is required for probe-arm output measurement after an exact same-family regression; do not assume receipt repair automatically closes arm-observer provenance.

external_primary_pattern.distilled_rule: Keep the identity of the instrumentation/emitting software unit explicit and typed rather than conflating it with the observed entity or opaque free-form provenance.

factory_rules: Require a concrete validated ObserverBinding produced by its deterministic factory/validator.
Store only observer_binding_sha256 in the canonical receipt payload unless exact implementation evidence justifies more fields.
Retain or otherwise make available the exact source ObserverBinding object/reference needed to recompute and verify the digest before summary admission.
Reject absent, malformed, stale-generation or digest-mismatched bindings at any path that claims observed uptake evidence.
Do not infer observer identity from provenance_refs, call stack, class name, log text or model output.
leaf_binding_candidate.summary_rule: summarize_uptake must revalidate every source receipt's observer binding before accepting its source_receipt_sha256; no additional summary-level observer field is required for identity propagation.
leaf_binding_candidate.result_rule: evaluate_causal_influence inherits receipt-observer lineage through uptake_summary_sha256; do not add a duplicate result-level observer field for the uptake receipt path.

required_trigger4_regressions_before_mut: Encode the E3 collision against exact current WP507 as an expected failing regression before source repair.
Two identical uptake observations with different valid ObserverBinding digests must produce different CellUptakeReceipt digests.
Two-cell observer assignment swap must change the resulting UptakeSummary digest when observer-to-cell mapping changes.
Direct receipt constructor or forged observer_binding_sha256 without valid source binding must fail closed.
ObserverBinding artifact/config/generation mutation after receipt construction must fail revalidation.
Opaque provenance_refs that happen to contain observer-like text must not substitute for a typed binding.
UptakeSummary rebuilt from exact source receipts must preserve observer-bound receipt digests deterministically.
CausalInfluenceResult built from that summary must change when the observer-bound summary digest changes.
Evidence class must never directly upgrade runtime/causal/truth/effect/completion credit.

probe_arm_followup_gate.reason: CausalProbeArm downstream outputs are also measurement leaves and currently lack typed producer identity.
probe_arm_followup_gate.required_before_claiming_full_wp507_obse: Run a separate exact-source same-family regression showing whether intervention/control output observer identity can alias or be mismatched while preserving current arm/result digests.
probe_arm_followup_gate.do_not_conflate_with: ProbeExecutionContext matching from R6-SEED-012; experimental-context matching and measurement-producer identity are orthogonal witnesses.

required_before_E6: Re-enter exact current F2 main and verify no newer WP507 successor already closes observer identity.
Acquire the canonical Trigger-4 mutation claim for the smallest nonduplicate WP507 successor.
Keep the initial repair in gwt_uptake.py unless exact current architecture already has a stronger shared evidence-binding primitive that can be reused without creating a second authority.
Prefer one small typed dataclass/validator plus one digest field over importing an observability/provenance framework.
Run repository CI at exact head and preserve all current zero-runtime/zero-whole-system credit boundaries.
If a stronger existing upstream typed witness is found, retire this local candidate rather than duplicate it.

supported: Promote a thin typed ObserverBinding primitive to E5 design-candidate status.
Bind uptake measurement-producer identity at CellUptakeReceipt leaf scope by digest.
Reuse existing receipt->summary->result digest lineage for transitive propagation.
Keep measurement-producer identity distinct from matched execution-context identity.
not_supported: No production WP507 mutation by Trigger 6.
No proof of real runtime false uptake or causal error.
No target-runtime, physical GRID10, GWT runtime, J-Space, model, training, effect, completion or whole-system credit.
adjudication.reason: One typed binding plus one leaf digest field reuses current canonical hashing and lineage structure and avoids a new service/store/provider dependency.

next_exact_action: Trigger 4 should claim the smallest WP507 successor and first admit the observer-aliasing regressions; only then implement/reuse the exact typed ObserverBinding at the receipt boundary and run exact-head CI. A separate Trigger-6/4 discriminator should test observer identity on CausalProbeArm outputs before claiming full WP507 measurement-producer closure.
